products.name: Organic Ceylon Cinnamon Powder
products.description: Finely ground organic Ceylon cinnamon with a light golden colour, a silky texture and a soft, sweet aroma. One ingredient, with nothing else added.
products.longDescription:
True Cinnamon, the Way Nature Made It

Open the jar, and the warm, sweet aroma of true Ceylon cinnamon greets you. Light golden and silky soft, it feels as pure as its scent. This isn't the dark, sharp cinnamon most people know. This is true Ceylon Cinnamon.

It begins in the green lowlands of Ceylon, where the cinnamon tree has grown for centuries. Skilled hands peel the inner bark, layer by paper-thin layer, and roll it into delicate quills that dry slowly in the shade. Only the finest quills of each harvest are chosen for this jar and ground into a fine, fragrant powder. One ingredient, certified organic, with nothing else added.

Gentle by nature

Ceylon cinnamon contains only about 0.004% coumarin, about a hundred times less than cassia, the common cinnamon on most shelves. That's why people choose it for daily use. Your morning cup, your bowl of oats and your slice of cake can all carry its warmth, with nothing to hold back.

What you'll notice

A softer, sweeter taste that never turns bitter

A golden colour and a scent that fills the kitchen

Only about 0.004% coumarin, made for everyday enjoyment

Certified organic: one pure ingredient

A silky texture that melts into drinks

Ways to enjoy it

Half a spoon in your morning coffee or tea. A light dusting over yogurt and fresh fruit. A warm note in cakes, breads and slow-cooked curries. Wherever it goes, it brings quiet comfort.

Questions

Is Ceylon cinnamon safe for daily use?

Yes. Ceylon cinnamon contains only about 0.004% coumarin. Cassia contains about a hundred times more, enough to strain the liver when eaten often in large amounts.

What are the health benefits of Ceylon cinnamon?

Supports balanced blood sugar levels

Promotes healthy cholesterol and lipid balance

Supports healthy blood pressure levels

Encourages overall cardiovascular wellness

Helps soothe and comfort the body naturally

Rich in antioxidants

Gentle on digestion

A gift from nature, not a medicine.

How is it different from regular cinnamon?

Most regular cinnamon is cassia, which is darker, harsher and high in coumarin. Ceylon cinnamon is lighter in colour, softer and sweeter in taste.

How should I store it?

Keep it tightly sealed in a dry place at room temperature, away from direct sunlight, to protect its warm, sweet aroma.

products.name: Ceylon Cinnamon Bark Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from the inner bark of true Ceylon cinnamon. A rich, sweet, warm aroma, offered in two cinnamaldehyde ranges and four bottle sizes.
products.longDescription:
True Ceylon Cinnamon, in Every Golden Drop

Since ancient times, it has been known as the "Elixir of the Gods". Its warm, sweet scent drifts through the room like a golden Ceylon sunset, slow and calm. Busy thoughts soften. The mind breathes again. Every golden drop holds the pure soul of true cinnamon.

It begins in the green lowlands of Ceylon. The inner bark of the cinnamon tree is gently steam-distilled to capture its purest essence.  That is why every drop is so rich, and so precious.

Pure Ceylon character

Our oil comes only from Ceylon cinnamon, never cassia. It is naturally rich in cinnamaldehyde, the gift that gives true cinnamon its sweet, warm scent and taste.

What you'll notice

A rich, sweet and warm cinnamon aroma

A deep golden colour

Strong and long-lasting: one drop goes a long way

Pure Ceylon cinnamon bark oil, nothing added

Made for your home, body, kitchen and craft

Ways to enjoy it

Diffuser: add 2 to 3 drops to water for a warm, welcoming home

Massage: blend 1 drop with 60 ml (4 tablespoons) of carrier oil, such as coconut or almond

Kitchen: a tiny touch flavours cakes, desserts and drinks. Dip a toothpick, then stir

Soap and candles: a rich, warm note for handmade soaps and candles

A few drops bring calm to your home and flavour to your meals.

Questions

Why use bark oil in food instead of cinnamon powder?

Pure, strong flavour: a single drop gives a whole cake, dessert or drink a deep cinnamon taste

Silky smooth: no powder, no gritty bits. Perfect for chocolate, ice cream, syrups and clear drinks

Beautiful to look at: your drinks and syrups stay clear, with only the flavour added

Enduring essence: one small bottle brings warmth to countless creations

Is it safe to use on skin?

Yes, when well diluted. Bark oil is very strong, so never use it straight on the skin. Use about 1 drop in 60 ml of carrier oil, test on a small patch of skin first, and keep it away from eyes. Not for children, or during pregnancy, without advice.

What are the health benefits of Ceylon cinnamon bark oil?

Warm, uplifting aroma that refreshes the mind

Naturally antimicrobial (in lab studies)

Warming comfort in a diluted massage

Freshens the air in your home

A gift from nature, not a medicine.

How is it different from cinnamon leaf oil?

Bark oil comes from the inner bark. It is sweet, rich and full of cinnamaldehyde. Leaf oil comes from the leaves and smells spicier, closer to clove. Bark oil is rarer and more precious.

How should I store it?

Keep the bottle tightly closed, away from heat and direct sunlight, and out of reach of children.

products.name: Ceylon Cinnamon Leaf Oil
products.description: Pure, steam-distilled Ceylon cinnamon leaf oil with a warm, spicy, clove-like aroma. For aroma, body and home care; not for food use.
products.longDescription:
The Spice Garden of Ceylon, in Every Drop

The world knows the bark of the cinnamon tree. Few know the treasure in its leaves. Ceylon cinnamon leaf oil is warm, spicy and bright, a scent that refreshes your home and lifts your mood in moments.

Its rich, spicy scent freshens the air, and its natural eugenol brings soothing warmth to tired muscles. Add it to your diffuser, your massage oil or your home care ritual. Wherever it goes, it leaves warmth, freshness and calm behind.

Pure Ceylon character

Silonka leaf oil comes only from Ceylon cinnamon, never cassia. It is naturally rich in eugenol, the same warm compound found in clove, which gives it its bold, spicy scent.

What you'll notice

A warm, spicy aroma

A golden-brown colour

Bright and energising, never heavy

Pure Ceylon cinnamon leaf oil, nothing added

Made for your home, body and craft

Ways to enjoy it

Diffuser: add 2 to 3 drops to water for a fresh, warm home

Massage: blend 1 drop with 10 ml (2 teaspoons) of carrier oil, such as coconut or almond

Home care: add a few drops to water for a Botanical Surface Refresh

Soap and candles: a warm, spicy note for handmade soaps and candles

A few drops, and your home feels warm and alive.

Questions

Can I use cinnamon leaf oil in food?

No. This oil is made for aroma, body and home care only. For cooking, choose our Ceylon Cinnamon Bark Oil or Ceylon Cinnamon Powder.

Is it safe to use on skin?

Yes, when well diluted. Never use it straight on the skin. Use about 1 drop in 10 ml of carrier oil, test on a small patch of skin first, and keep it away from eyes. Not for children, during pregnancy, or if you take blood-thinning medicine, without advice.

What are the health benefits of Ceylon cinnamon leaf oil?

Warm, energising aroma that lifts the mood

Naturally antimicrobial (in lab studies)

Soothing warmth for tired muscles in a diluted massage

Freshens the air in your home

A gift from nature, not a medicine.

How is it different from cinnamon bark oil?

Leaf oil comes from the leaves. It is spicy, bright and clove-like, and rich in eugenol. Bark oil comes from the inner bark and is sweeter and richer. Leaf oil is gentler on the skin and perfect for home and body care.

How should I store it?

Keep the bottle tightly closed, away from heat and direct sunlight, and out of reach of children.

products.name: Ceylon Cinnamon Sticks (Alba)
products.description: Fine Alba-grade Ceylon cinnamon quills, hand-peeled and rolled in Sri Lanka. Light golden layers with a delicate texture and a gentle, sweet flavour.
products.longDescription:
The Finest Cinnamon in the World

Among all the grades of Ceylon cinnamon, Alba stands alone. Only the finest, most delicate inner bark of the cinnamon tree can become Alba. It is the rarest grade of all, and the most treasured.

Every Alba quill carries an ancient secret that Ceylon's cinnamon peelers have passed down, from generation to generation, for centuries. It gives Alba its soft, smooth texture and a sweet, gentle flavour that never turns bitter. It is this centuries-old secret that makes Ceylon cinnamon second to none.

Gentle by nature

Like all true Ceylon cinnamon, Alba is naturally low in coumarin. You can enjoy it every day, in every cup.

What you'll notice

The finest grade of Ceylon cinnamon

A light golden colour and a smooth surface

A soft, sweet flavour with no bitterness

Many delicate layers that break easily

Naturally low in coumarin, made for daily use

Ways to enjoy it

Tea and coffee: add one stick to your cup, or use it to stir

Cinnamon water: simmer one stick in water for 10 minutes for a warm, soothing drink

Cooking: add to rice, curries, soups and slow-cooked dishes

Desserts and drinks: lovely in puddings, mulled wine and hot chocolate

Gifting: a beautiful gift for anyone who loves fine food

Once you taste true Ceylon cinnamon, there's no going back to cassia.

Questions

What does "Alba" mean?

Alba is the highest grade of Ceylon cinnamon. Only the finest inner bark, in the hands of the most skilled peelers, can become Alba. That is why it is the most treasured grade of all.

How can I tell true Ceylon cinnamon sticks from cassia?

True Ceylon sticks are light in colour and made of many soft, delicate layers. They break easily in your hand. Cassia sticks are thick, dark and hard, made of one single layer.

What are the health benefits of Ceylon cinnamon?

Promotes healthy cholesterol and lipid balance

Supports healthy blood pressure levels

Encourages overall cardiovascular wellness

Natural anti-inflammatory

Rich in antioxidants

Gentle on digestion

A gift from nature, not a medicine.

How should I store it?

Keep it tightly sealed in a dry place at room temperature, away from direct sunlight, to protect its warm, sweet aroma.

products.name: Ceylon Cinnamon Candle
products.description: A hand-poured soy wax candle made with pure Ceylon cinnamon leaf oil and a natural wick. A warm, spicy scent in a container to keep and reuse.
products.longDescription:
The Warmth of Ceylon, in Candlelight

On every evening that calls for calm, light a Silonka candle. Its soft glow and the warm, spicy scent of Ceylon cinnamon slowly turn your room into a calm, peaceful space, and gently melt away the tiredness of the day.

Every Silonka candle is made with natural soy wax and the finest Ceylon cinnamon oil, so you enjoy only natural scent. It burns clean and gentle, and when the last light fades, its beautiful container is yours to keep.

What you'll notice

A warm, spicy scent that gently fills the room

Natural soy wax that burns clean

A steady, calm flame from a natural wick

Hand-poured in Ceylon, one by one

A beautiful container to keep and reuse

Ways to enjoy it

After a long day: light it, sit back and breathe

When guests arrive: a warm welcome as soon as they walk in

Bath time: a soft glow while you unwind

As a gift: a little piece of Ceylon for someone you love

Light it, and feel the calm.

Questions

What is it made of?

Just three things: natural soy wax, pure Ceylon cinnamon leaf oil and a natural wick. Every candle is poured by hand in Ceylon.

Why soy wax?

Soy wax comes from plants. It burns cleaner and more gently than regular paraffin, so all you notice is the pure scent of Ceylon cinnamon oil.

How do I get the best burn?

The first time you light it, let it burn until the whole top has melted. This helps it burn evenly every time after. Before each use, trim the wick for a clean, steady flame.

Is it safe to use?

Never leave a burning candle alone. Keep it away from children, pets, curtains and anything that can catch fire. Place it on a flat, heat-safe surface.

Can I reuse the container?

Yes. Once the candle is finished, clean out any leftover wax with warm water. Then use it for flowers, small plants or little treasures.

How should I store it?

Keep it at room temperature, away from heat and direct sunlight, to protect its scent and colour.

products.name: Silonka CinnaChew — Cinnamon Wood Dog Chew
products.description: A handcrafted, bark-free Ceylon cinnamon wood chew with a natural golden-brown finish and distinctive cinnamon aroma. Available in Small, Medium and Large.
products.longDescription:
CinnaChew

Ceylon Cinnamon Wood Dog Chew

A Natural Chew for Happier, Healthier Dogs

Give your best friend something special to chew on.

Made from natural Ceylon cinnamon wood, this chew offers a unique chewing experience with the natural aroma of Ceylon cinnamon.

More than just a chew, it gives your dog a simple way to enjoy a natural behavior while keeping boredom away.

Why Your Dog Will Love It

Supports Dental Care

Chewing creates gentle friction against the teeth, which may help reduce plaque build-up. Regular chewing can support your dog's dental care routine.

Helps Relieve Boredom

Dogs naturally love to chew. This chew gives them an engaging activity to enjoy, helping keep their minds occupied and reducing boredom.

Encourages Calm Behaviors

Chewing can help dogs relax and manage everyday stress. It provides a comforting activity that can help them settle down.

Supports Natural Chewing Instincts

Chewing is a natural behavior for dogs. This Cinnamon chew gives your dog an outlet for that instinct and may help redirect chewing away from furniture, shoes and other household items.

A Unique Natural Aroma

Made from Ceylon cinnamon wood, this chew brings a distinctive natural aroma to your dog's chewing experience.

Heart Health Benefit

Ceylon Cinnamon Dog Chew may improve heart health of your pet. (journal of Animal & Veterinary Advances, 11(19): 3604-3608, 2012)

Specifications

Material: 100% Bark-Free Ceylon Cinnamon Wood (Cinnamomum zeylanicum )

Color: Golden Brown

Handcrafted Toy

100% Natural

100% Chemical-Free

Size | Length | Diameter Range | Approximate Weight

Small | 14~15cm | 24~30mm | 50~75g

Medium | 18~19cm | 29~34mm | 80~130g

Large | 22~23cm | 34~50mm | 140~240g

Always check the diameter and Length before selecting a size.

How to Use

Always supervise your dog while chewing.

Remove any small pieces immediately to reduce the risk of choking.

Although Ceylon cinnamon wood is generally less likely to produce sharp splinters, strong chewers may break the stick. Replace it immediately if it cracks, breaks or develops loose pieces.

Replace the chew every three months for the best aroma and chewing experience, or sooner if it becomes damaged.

A Little Natural Joy for Your Best Friend

Your pet brings happiness, loyalty and love into your life every day. Give them a natural chewing experience they can enjoy as part of their daily routine.

Silonka CinnaChewRooted in Nature. Inspired by Ceylon. Made for the Love They Give.
